issue_context.title: When gathering package facts on an Alpine node where the apk cache is not populated, a warning is emitted and the package gathering returns no result
issue_context.body:
### Summary

I was trying to get the packages of an Alpine node and was curious to see no result from the `package_facts` module. It turns out that the command used `apk info -v` emits a warning on stderr when the apk cache is not populated, although the command ends up listing the packages successfully, and, because of the warning emitted in stderr, the package gathering in the module ends up failing. 

Here is an example of the said command, its stdout silenced:
```console
# apk info -v >/dev/null
WARNING: opening from cache https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/main: No such file or directory
WARNING: opening from cache https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/community: No such file or directory
```
The command still works though:
```console
# apk info -v
WARNING: opening from cache https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/main: No such file or directory
WARNING: opening from cache https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/community: No such file or directory
.python-rundeps-20240627.001414
#### other irrelevant packages do come in this list, cut for brevity
# echo $?
0
```

In order to reproduce it on any Alpine node, one can do:
```console
rm /var/cache/apk/*
```

### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

package_facts

### Ansible Version

```console
ansible [core 2.17.1]
  config file = /usr/local/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/nobody/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /home/nobody/.local/share/pipx/venvs/ansible/lib/python3.12/site-packages/ansible
  ansible collection location = /home/nobody/.ansible/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections
  executable location = /home/nobody/.local/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.12.4 (main, Jun 27 2024, 00:10:56) [GCC 13.2.1 20240309] (/home/nobody/.local/share/pipx/venvs/ansible/bin/python)
  jinja version = 3.1.4
  libyaml = True
```


### Configuration

```console
CONFIG_FILE() = /usr/local/ansible/ansible.cfg
DEFAULT_HOST_LIST(/usr/local/ansible/ansible.cfg) = ['/usr/local/ansible/inventories']
DEFAULT_STDOUT_CALLBACK(/usr/local/ansible/ansible.cfg) = yaml

SHELL:
=====

sh:
__
remote_tmp(/usr/local/ansible/ansible.cfg) = /tmp
```


### OS / Environment

Alpine Linux 3.20.1

### Steps to Reproduce

<!--- Paste example playbooks or commands between quotes below -->
Run the two tasks:
```yaml
- package_facts:
    manager: apk 

- debug:
    var: ansible_facts.packages
```


### Expected Results

The debug should have listed me the packages installed on that node

### Actual Results

A warning is emitted and the debug task lists nothing:

```console
TASK [package_facts] *************************************************************************
[WARNING]: Requested package manager apk was not usable by this module: Unable to list packages rc=0 : WARNING: opening from cache
https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/main: No such file or directory WARNING: opening from cache https://dl-
cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/community: No such file or directory
ok: [localhost]

TASK [debug] *********************************************************************************
ok: [localhost] => 
  ansible_facts.packages: {}
```

comments:
Files identified in the description:

* [`lib/ansible/modules/package_facts.py`](https://github.com/ansible/ansible/blob/devel/lib/ansible/modules/package_facts.py)

If these files are incorrect, please update the `component name` section of the description or use the [component](https://github.com/ansible/ansibotmini#commands) bot command.

<!--- boilerplate: components_banner --->

From Alpine 3.2 on, `apk info -v`  accepts a `--no-cache` flag, so that could be a way to solve it for those versions and onwards.
There is still an issue with this, though, because running it this way would yield
```
# apk info -v --no-cache
fetch https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/main/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz
fetch https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.20/community/x86_64/APKINDEX.tar.gz
.python-rundeps-20240627.001414
# other packages here, irrelevant
```

And those fetch lines would be considered packages if the `get_package_details` method is not adapted to take this into account.

review_comments:
This change isn't in devel. Why wasn't this change made there first?

Also, what's the relationship between this change and the integration test changes?

The change is available in `devel` via https://github.com/ansible/ansible/pull/83132 

The integration test makes sure that package fact dict is populated `ansible_facts.packages | length > 1`
Ah, I had missed that since the module change and the tests were from separate PRs. Thanks.
